challenge.name: Build a company research agent
challenge.requirements: Build an agent that researches the right company, links facts to sources, and checks for changes. Test it locally on 100 companies; Builderr supplies the same official company batch to every eligible entry.
challenge.task: Turn an organisation number into a useful profile: resolve the public identity, collect permitted official and public evidence, answer supported questions, and detect changes without overwriting history.

interface.output: one completed company record with a source for each fact, explicit missing-data labels, and update timestamps

reward.split: $2,000 main pool ($1,200/$500/$300) plus $500 JBOX bonus ($250/$150/$100); four $100 community-vote awards are separate.
reward.benchmark: The published qualification bar and locked evaluator fixture.

constraints.public_fixture: 411,160 Norway-registered entities with observed 2025 annual-account records; 100-company local smoke test; larger local tests encouraged
constraints.hidden_tests: the current official company batch selected after each cutoff; every eligible frozen entry receives the same batch, including when the shared set grows
constraints.network: Fixed time and resource budget per official batch; the same limits apply to every eligible entry
constraints.missing_data: show not available; never convert missing values to zero
constraints.revisions: initial version plus up to four revised exact commits by 18 October; revisions apply only to later batches
constraints.missed_runs: entrant-caused failure after clean reproduction scores zero; Builderr or shared-source failure is void and rerun with the same frozen code
constraints.sparse_recall: recall is reported as not measured below 15 positive company-field opportunities across at least three external field families; it is not a qualification gate

challenge.scoring: 100 points: recall and coverage 50; precision and evidence 30; decision-useful synthesis 12; UX and interaction 8. External coverage is 70% company recall and 30% claim recall against the cumulative checked reference set; every entrant is rescored whenever that set expands. Qualification requires an official run and 65 overall; coverage, recall and precision are scored dimensions, not separate qualification thresholds. Public voting never changes technical ranking.

methods.instructions: Email a public repository URL or private access path, your 100-company smoke-test report, the run command, models/APIs used, and the expected cost per official run.
